observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR body with 'Canon' logo on the front and '800' visible on the right side; lens is attached.
Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with buttons and a small screen; no clear model text visible on this angle.
Photo 2 shows the top/right side with 'EOS 800' visible and the lens attached; lens front cap is not clearly shown.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Photos show a Canon EOS 800D body with a standard zoom lens attached, but the lens focal length '18-55mm' is not clearly readable in the provided images.
Photos show 'Canon' branding on the camera body (photo 0 and photo 2), not Sony.

risks.risk: Wrong item / mismatch with seller text (seller says Sony, but photos clearly show Canon EOS 800D).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the camera front/top showing the brand/model text and a photo of the lens nameplate showing '18-55mm'.
risks.if_unproven: Price as Canon EOS 800D with lens, but treat as worst-case for accessories/condition not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 18-55mm (could be different Canon/third-party lens).
risks.proof: Request a close-up photo of the lens barrel text (where focal length is printed) and the lens mount markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic kit zoom lens of unknown exact spec.

risks.risk: Condition/working status not shown (shutter count, sensor dust, autofocus, buttons, screen, and battery health).
risks.proof: Request a short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a face/object, and a sample photo at a bright scene + a close-up of the rear screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified/possible faults (worst-case: needs service).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card, lens caps) not shown.
risks.proof: Request a laid-out photo of everything included (battery, charger, both lens caps, strap, manuals, memory card).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal included items only (camera + lens), no extras.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the lens barrel text showing the exact focal length (e.g., '18-55mm') and lens model.
Photo of the camera label/serial area (or a clear top/right shot) confirming EOS 800D.
Video test: power on, rear screen works, menu works, autofocus locks on, and a sample photo output.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, lens caps, strap, memory card if any).
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Canon EOS 800D body, but the seller’s text is inconsistent (claims Sony) and the key pricing drivers (exact lens spec, working condition, and included accessories) are not verifiable from the images.
